description:
Use this when an agent needs official US government alert streams: USGS earthquakes, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, openFDA drug recalls, or Federal Register documents. kind="intuitive" (the default) is the latest item from one stream (pass stream=usgs_quakes, cisa_kev, openfda_recalls or federal_register); kind="stats" is recent items; kind="pro" is a digest of all four; kind="signals" is computed flags (for example a magnitude 6+ quake or a Class I recall). The push_* names return the same items at 25 sats each. Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice. Example: get_alerts_data(kind="intuitive", stream="usgs_quakes"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 5 sats or $0.003 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the latest official item from one government stream (USGS earthquakes, CISA KEV, openFDA recalls, or the Federal Register). Pass stream=usgs_quakes (the default), cisa_kev, openfda_recalls or federal_register. Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice, and not a buy, sell or hold.
- kind="stats": 17 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the recent official items from one government stream, not just the latest. Pass stream= and optional limit=. Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice, and not a buy, sell or hold. Not affiliated with or endorsed by USGS, CISA, the FDA, NARA or the Federal Register. Verify against the official source before acting.
- kind="pro": 33 sats or $0.02 USDC. Use this when an agent needs a digest of the latest official items across USGS, CISA KEV, openFDA recalls and the Federal Register in one call. Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice, and not a buy, sell or hold. Not affiliated with or endorsed by USGS, CISA, the FDA, NARA or the Federal Register.
- kind="signals": 33 sats or $0.02 USDC. Use this when an agent needs computed flags on official items (for example a magnitude 6+ earthquake, a CISA KEV labeled known ransomware, a Class I recall, or a Federal Register rule). Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice, and not a buy, sell or hold. Not affiliated with or endorsed by USGS, CISA, the FDA, NARA or the Federal Register.
- kind="standalone": 5 sats or $0.003 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the latest official Federal Register documents item. Same data as alerts_intuitive?stream=federal_register, at a 5 sats / $0.003 pull price. Feed updates are about 3 sats / $0.0015. Informational only, not medical, legal or safety advice, and not a buy, sell or hold.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

stream.description: Official stream: usgs_quakes (default), cisa_kev, openfda_recalls or federal_register.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
